name: Microsoft
reason: The provincial reports print Microsoft's awards as Microsoft, Microsoft Canada Inc. and Microsoft Cooperation, for the same Enterprise Agreement licences and Unified Support contracts to the same buyers, with addresses in Toronto, Mississauga and Reno (Microsoft's licensing office). reason: A misprint of Microsoft Corporation (see the Microsoft line above): one 2023 licence award to the NL Centre for Health Information, Reno address.

reason: Federal grant records 141-2019-2020-Q1-13406 (Norris Arm) and 141-2021-2022-Q2-03025 (Baie Verte) print business-number root 107876468, as do the named Grand Falls records (for example 141-2020-2021-Q4-03187, Tilting).
